objective: Candidate turns a pizza inside an oven; PR-1591 grinds peppercorns in a mortar and returns the pestle.
physical_skill: Candidate requires long-peel steering, blade entry, and repeated low-lift tangential strokes; PR-1591 requires bimanual stabilization and sustained circular rubbing with a pestle.
success_condition: Candidate scores yaw, center excursion, continuous deck contact, integrity, release, and peel withdrawal. PR-1591 scores accumulated valid rubbing, complete grinding, mortar stability, pestle replacement, and arm return.
reason: Although both use circular tool motion while an item remains supported, grinding by repeated compressive rubbing is a different tested ability from under-edge pizza rotation.
